**Manchester United Secures Manuel Ugarte in High-Profile Move**

Manchester United has finalized the acquisition of Manuel Ugarte from Paris Saint-Germain in a deal worth €50 million, with an additional €10 million in potential bonuses. The 23-year-old Uruguayan international has committed to a five-year agreement, with the possibility of extending it by another year. This signing marks the fifth significant addition under manager Erik ten Hag, reinforcing the squad’s depth in the midfield alongside Casemiro.

Ugarte expressed his enthusiasm for joining the historic club, stating, “It is an incredible feeling to be part of an institution with such global admiration. The vision shared by the leadership is truly inspiring. Manchester United’s ambition aligns with my own, and I am eager to contribute to the team’s success.” He emphasized his dedication, adding, “The passion of the supporters is unmatched, and I am excited to step onto the pitch at Old Trafford. My focus is on hard work and unity with my teammates as we strive for silverware and restore the club’s prominence.”

Dan Ashworth, United’s sporting director, highlighted the strategic importance of the signing, noting, “Bringing Manuel on board was a key objective for us this summer.”

Any other questions?
